panels.title: Wall time: % above best build (median)
panels.description: One line per test, one point per release at its npm publication time. Each line is normalized to the best build that test had in the time range: 0% = fastest, and a line drifting upward means the test is getting slower build over build. Filter network/size/surface to compare like with like.

targets.expr: 100 * avg by (device_type, scenario, surface, size, network) (last_over_time(t3perf_wall_ms{time_basis="release", scenario=~"$scenario", stat="median", build!="", label=~"$label", network=~"$network", size=~"$size", surface=~"$surface", device_type=~"$device_type"}[$__interval])) / on (device_type, scenario, surface, size, network) group_left () (min by (device_type, scenario, surface, size, network) (min_over_time(t3perf_wall_ms{time_basis="release", stat="median", build!="", label=~"$label", network=~"$network", size=~"$size", surface=~"$surface", device_type=~"$device_type"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0) - 100
